## Change

What changed and why? Link a related issue if there is one.

## Checks

List the commands and results, plus anything not tested. Include a screenshot for a UI change.

## Compatibility

Does this affect supported models, saved traces, dependencies or installation? Say so here.

- [ ] The change is focused and includes relevant tests or an explanation.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, model weights or generated captures are included.
